_comment: Copy this file to vulnerabilities.json (or point -vuln-config at it) to hand-add known-vulnerable plugin/theme/core version ranges. This file is never touched by `wpscan vulns update` — that command only writes vulnerabilities.wordfence.json. Keep your own entries here so the two never clash.

_fields.slug: the wp-cli slug — same value `wp plugin list --fields=name` / `wp theme list --fields=name` prints, e.g. 'akismet'. For core use slug 'wordpress'.
_fields.from_version: '*' (or omit) for no lower bound, otherwise a dotted version like '1.0.0'.
_fields.to_inclusive: true if to_version itself is still vulnerable (the common case for '<= 1.2.3' advisories).
_fields.severity: critical | high | warning | medium | info | low
_fields.note: optional free-text — why you added this, what to do about it

vulnerabilities.name: Example Plugin
vulnerabilities.title: Example Plugin <= 1.2.3 - Authenticated Arbitrary File Upload
vulnerabilities.note: No official patch as of writing — deactivate or remove until a fixed version ships.
